change_summary: Increase feature flag 'new_search_ranking' from 25% to 75% of users. The flag has been at 25% for 14 days with positive metrics. This is step 3 of a 4-stage rollout plan.
diff_or_config:
--- a/flags/search_ranking.yaml
+++ b/flags/search_ranking.yaml
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@
 new_search_ranking:
   enabled: true
-  rollout_percentage: 25
+  rollout_percentage: 75
   stage: 3_of_4
   targeting:
     - all_users
   kill_switch: enabled
service_context: search-service handles 120k queries/min. New ranking algorithm uses ML model v2 (deployed 30 days ago). At 25% rollout: +3.2% click-through rate, -1.1% bounce rate, no latency regression.
deployment_plan: Staged rollout: 5% (done, 7 days) -> 25% (done, 14 days) -> 75% (this change, planned 7 days) -> 100%. Flag change is instant via config push. No deployment needed.
rollback_plan: Rollback trigger: if search_ctr drops >5% relative or p99 latency exceeds 200ms for 5 minutes. Rollback action: set rollout_percentage back to 25 via LaunchDarkly UI or CLI 'ld flag update new_search_ranking --rollout 25'. Kill switch disables instantly if critical.
observability_evidence: Grafana dashboard: grafana.internal/d/search-ranking-experiment (panels: CTR by cohort, bounce rate, p99 latency by flag variant, error rate). LaunchDarkly experimentation metrics tracked. Segment-level analytics in Amplitude for A/B comparison.
alerting_evidence: Alerts: search_error_rate > 1% for 3min (PagerDuty critical). search_p99_latency > 200ms for 5min (PagerDuty warning). search_ctr_drop > 5% relative over 1hr (Slack #search-alerts). All alerts have been active during 25% rollout with zero firings.
owner_oncall_evidence: Owner: search-team. On-call: @search-oncall rotation (3 engineers). Escalation: search-lead (Maria Chen) -> Engineering Director. Product owner: Alex Kim (approved 75% stage).
slo_reliability_impact: search-service SLO: 99.95% availability, p99 < 150ms. At 25% rollout over 14 days: SLO maintained with 0 violations. Error budget: 85% remaining. Projected impact at 75%: no SLO risk based on 25% performance data.
blast_radius: search-service only. Flag is client-side evaluated so backend behavior unchanged. Worst case: 75% of users see suboptimal ranking (reverts in <30s via kill switch). No cascading failure risk.
validation_evidence: 14-day A/B test at 25% with statistical significance (p<0.01) on CTR improvement. Load tested search-service at full traffic with new ranking: no latency difference. Integration tests pass with both flag states. Manual QA on 50 representative queries confirmed relevance improvement.
